subject: [PATCH v2 5/5] mm/mmzone: read each zoneref slot once when filtering by nodemask

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch improves the performance of the __next_zones_zonelist() function by reading each zoneref slot only once when filtering by nodemask. The original code read the slot twice, which could lead to a NULL pointer dereference when offlining a zone's last block and rebuilding the zonelists in place. The patch fixes this issue by testing the zone directly after reading the slot, and it also removes unnecessary inline functions and simplifies the code.
